outcome: complications (enteral feeding adjustment, partial exchange transfusions)
cohort: The study included all neonates more than 37 weeks of gestation born at the Sri Jayewardenepura Teaching Hospital.
finding: The incidence of polycythaemia was 17.5%, and neonatal polycythaemia was significantly associated with the delivery method.
mod_finding: Neonatal polycythaemia was significantly associated with the delivery method (p=0.019).
